title: Ticket Brief
description: Structured extraction from a Jira ticket, produced before generation starts. Keeps 'what does the ticket actually ask for' explicit and separate from the agent's interpretation, so requireTicketPriorityTraceability (composition-heuristics) has something concrete to check against.

rawDescription.description: Verbatim (paraphrased per copyright practice if fetched from Jira text) ticket description, kept for traceability.

priorities.description: The core things this design must accomplish, ranked. Every major generation decision must cite one of these.

source.description: 'explicit' = stated directly in the ticket. 'acceptance-criterion' = derived from a listed AC. 'inferred' = the agent's read on unstated intent — flagged separately so it can be confirmed rather than assumed.

requiredElements.description: Concrete UI needs pulled from the ticket, each destined for the reuse/similarity check against the manifest's components[].

description.description: e.g. 'a way to show 4 KPIs with trend indicators'.

linkedPriority.description: id of the priority this element serves, for traceability.

estimatedVolume.description: If this is a list/collection, rough expected item count — feeds compositionHeuristics.listPaginationThreshold check, e.g. '~30 rows, grows over time'.

constraints.description: Explicit constraints from the ticket (platform, deadline-driven scope cuts, must-integrate-with-X, etc.).

linkedDesigns.description: URLs/references to existing designs mentioned in the ticket (Figma links, prior screens) that this should be visually consistent with.

openQuestions.description: Ambiguities the agent couldn't resolve from the ticket alone — surfaced to the human before generation starts rather than silently assumed.
